title: Understanding the Intercept
text: The intercept \( $$\theta_0$$ \) in a regression model represents the predicted value of the dependent variable when all independent variables are zero. Think about what it means for a student to have $$0$$ hours of sleep and not be affiliated with CDSS.

hintAnswer: Predicted GPA for a student who gets $$0$$ hours of sleep and does not have a CDSS affiliated major.
title: Identify the Variables
text: What does it mean for the variables $$hours_{sleep}$$ and $$is_{cdss}$$ to be zero in this context?
choices: Predicted GPA for a student who gets $$0$$ hours of sleep and does not have a CDSS affiliated major.
Predicted increase in GPA for one additional hour of sleep, holding CDSS major status constant.
Predicted GPA difference between CDSS affiliated and non CDSS affiliated majors, holding sleep constant.
Average GPA of all students in the dataset.
